The script uses standard tooling like `curl`, `jq`, and `updpkgsums`, which are typical in AUR maintainer workflows.

All network requests are directed to GitHub's official API and release download endpoints under the expected repository (`ahmedmoselhi/distro-grub-themes`). The assets fetched are listed via the public API and filtered safely using `jq`. The script generates source URLs pointing to GitHub releases and sets up the build process to extract and install the themes into the standard GRUB themes directory. The use of `md5sums=(123)` is a placeholder and will be replaced by `updpkgsums`, which is standard practice in such generation scripts.

There is no evidence of malicious behavior: no data exfiltration, no execution of downloaded code, no obfuscation, and no unauthorized system modifications. The script performs a legitimate automation task common among AUR maintainers and operates within expected boundaries.
</details>
